name: audio_voice_change
description: Voice changer (ElevenLabs speech-to-speech): re-speaks an existing audio recording with another voice (catalog or the user's ElevenLabs clone), preserving the original performance (timing, delivery, emotion). Get `voiceId` from `audio_voices_list` or `audio_voices_show`.

audioUrl.description: Asset URL or a creation `identifier` (e.g. from `audio_tts`) to re-speak.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

similarityBoost.description: 0-1; default 0.75. Higher stays closer to the target voice.

source.description: mine=cloned My Voice; catalog=shared. Default catalog, so pass mine for a clone.

voiceId.description: Target voice ID from `audio_voices_list` or `audio_voices_show`. ElevenLabs only.
